Indian boxer Sachin Siwach advances in CWG 2026

Indian boxer Sachin Siwach has advanced to the pre-quarterfinals (Round of 16) of the 60kg category at the Commonwealth Games 2026. He secured his victory by defeating his opponent, Keoma Al-Ahmadieh, from Canada.
